## Closed `not_planned` — a `tooling` text fix with no unlock object while its lane's queue has open P1s

Path: fleet decision — a seat lands a governed PR in the ruling-C order | 缺项 | none

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T05:44Z. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main` `d999617`.

**The contradiction is real**: the `AGENTS.md` backstop paragraph and `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` still narrate 「交人类合并」 / "the human merge is the review record", while ruling C and the guard's own printed remedy (since PR #10413) say draft, then an authorized approval, then the claiming seat lands it.

**Why it closes** (the triage rules, not a new judgement): the fix lands in agent instructions and contributor docs about the fleet's own merge path, so it is `tooling`, and `AGENTS.md` is not a declared contract in the filing-gate sense. A `tooling` card enters `pm:queue` only with `Unblocks: #N` naming an open product card, and while its lane's queue has open P0/P1 cards (`domain:skills`: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20084 and #20088 are open P1), a p2/p3 `tooling` card with no unlock object is closed. The guard itself — the mechanical authority a seat meets at landing — already prints the right order.

**The repair, for whoever reopens this or next edits that section**: the one-clause rewrite the card proposes, plus the three docs sentences; one Tier H PR, serial with any other edit to that section.

**Reopen when** either holds: (1) a seat mis-lands, or holds, a governed PR because it followed the stale text — name the PR; or (2) the `domain:skills` queue has no open P0/P1.
